[[File:Gaiden Camo.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A [[Warder]] in his cloak.]]
'''Color-shifting cloaks''' are special garments that are unique to [[Warder]]s. Made out of a special material called [[fancloth]], they seem to mimic the surrounding landscape and serve as camouflage.

[[File:Lan saliba.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[al'Lan Mandragoran]] in his cloak.]]
Warder's cloaks tend to invoke a disturbing feeling on people who see them while they are moving, and while stationary the wearer blends in nearly perfectly with the background. The cloaks are somewhat of a trademark for Warders, and as such, can be used to recognize a Warder and his [[Aes Sedai]] on sight.

The fabric for the color shifting cloaks is made by a certain ''[[Fancloth ter'angreal|ter'angreal]]'' in the [[White Tower]] which has no other known use. {{Ref/book|8|2}}
